visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Extreme close-up of thick udon noodles coated in a rich, reddish-brown mapo-style sauce being lifted by black chopsticks. (2) Static shot of a restaurant entrance with glass sliding doors, posters of udon dishes, and a menu board outside. (3) A chef wearing black gloves uses tongs to stir-fry tofu and vegetables on a small iron skillet over a bright orange gas flame. (4) Close-up of a steaming hot iron skillet being served on a wooden platter, containing udon noodles topped with sprouts, meat, and seaweed. (5) A bowl of udon noodles topped with mapo tofu cubes, shredded chicken, broccoli, and a lime slice is presented on a wooden table. (6) Another close-up lift of the noodles, emphasizing the glossy texture and the thick sauce clinging to the strands. (7) Quick cuts show various udon dishes including a spicy Dan Dan style with ground meat, peanuts, and broccoli. (8) Wide shot of the restaurant interior featuring wooden tables, light-colored chairs, and walls entirely covered in Japanese anime and manga posters. (9) Final shot shows the restaurant's exterior sign 'Ma Yi Fan' in red and a detailed look at the storefront menu before ending.
